name: How To Choose Text Block
description:
• Find the cabin model and serial label - usually inside the door frame or on the power box.
  • Measure the fan frame and the blade diameter, plus the depth of the opening.
  • Check the voltage printed on the old motor; most home cabins in the US run 110-120V.
  • Match the wiring: spade terminals, screw posts or a plug-in harness.
  • Note where the fan sits - cabin wall, heater bay or control box - because airflow direction and heat rating differ for each position.

If the label is unreadable, photograph the fan in place together with its wiring and we will identify it for you.
